subject: POC kickoff: availability, payload handoff, and load/run coordination
messages:
From: Simon Lam <simon.lam@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 16:27:00 -0800
Subject: POC kickoff: availability, payload handoff, and load/run coordination

Marcus —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re ready to sign off on a short POC to validate routing and cost/latency tradeoffs for our triage workflow. A couple quick asks so we can get the working session scheduled:  

- Proposed window: week of Dec 20 — we prefer mornings PT (10:00–13:00 PT).
- We’ll provide a sanitized sample payload (CSV) but need guidance on minimal required fields + redaction checklist.
- Our target run shapes: steady-state 6 TPS with 400-token averages and a 90-second long-tail; we’d like one 10-minute burst test at ~25 TPS.
- Can you confirm who from Redwood will drive prompt review and the routing/load test plan?

I can send a redacted sample if you confirm the required schema. If Dec 21 or Dec 22 morning PT works, let’s lock a 90-minute hands-on slot (prompt review + live routing + short load run).

— Simon
Brightline Health
Senior Product Manager
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Simon Lam <simon.lam@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 18:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: availability, payload handoff, and load/run coordination

Simon — thanks for the context, this is great. Dec 21 at 10:00 PT looks good on our side (I’ll pencil it in). Quick answers and next steps below: 

- Redwood leads: I’ll cover prompt/workflow review and routing policy mapping; Neha will own load-test orchestration and metrics (latency percentiles / error breakdown); Soojin will handle redaction guidance and ingest validation.
- Minimal sample schema: id, user_message, metadata.case_type, created_at, and an optional priority flag. We prefer UTF-8 CSV; max 10k rows for initial evaluation.
- Redaction checklist (attached): remove PHI, replace real names with pseudonyms, hash any real IDs, and remove free-text notes that contain patient identifiers. See attached sample-handoff-checklist.pdf for the specifics.
- Load/run plan: we’ll start with single-node baseline followed by autoscaling test. Plan: 10-minute steady at 6 TPS, then a 10-minute burst ramp to 25 TPS. We’ll record p50/p90/p99 and end-to-end routing decisions.

Action items:
- Simon: share the redacted CSV and a short evaluation set (200 rows) by Monday so we can pre-stage caches.
- Marcus/Neha/Soojin: confirm calendar invite and attach runbook + ingest schema.

I attached a short YAML with the load-run template (poc-load-script.yaml) and the handoff checklist. If Dec 21 10:00 PT is confirmed I’ll send the calendar invite with Zoom + shared Drive folder.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

--
Marcus Lin
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
